newsitem.title: UK: Novorossiisk berth no 1 may close in Dec - trade.
newsitem.headline: Novorossiisk berth no 1 may close in Dec - trade.

text.p: The largest crude oil loading berth in Russia's main export terminal at Novorossiisk may close for maintenance for 15 days in December, Mediterranean crude traders said on Friday.

"In December there is a big question mark over maintenance of berth number one," a big Urals customer said. "We have no official confirmation from the agents, but it seems it is 99 percent confirmed."
He said Novorossiisk's berth number one would probably close from Dec 9-24. Number one is the largest of the four crude loading berths and can load cargoes containing up to one million barrels.
Berths two, six and seven can load only 60,000-80,000 tonnes.
The trader said the closure would probably increase the cost of Urals crude, partly because freight on smaller ships is higher.
